artifacts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one transparent strategy-game icon.
The reference supplies ONLY material finish, colour palette and contents. DO NOT copy its camera, diamond-shaped outline, perspective, silhouette, or visible facades. Create a newly reconstructed STRICT VERTICAL NADIR VIEW of its Stone Age settlement.

ABSOLUTE VIEW GEOMETRY: This is a roof plan, seen from a satellite directly above. Ground plane parallel to the image plane. Camera exactly 90 degrees downward, orthographic projection, no perspective. Every circular horizontal shape MUST be a perfect circle. All buildings rise toward the viewer, never lean toward the top of the image. Zero visible wall elevations anywhere. Roofs completely hide every hut wall and door. All fence posts are seen from the very top, showing small round tops only; no vertical shafts. No exterior side wall at the bottom of the icon. Front and back edges have IDENTICAL width. The whole icon must read as a circular map tile rather than an upright 3D miniature. Perfect circular palisade plan; NOT elongated, NOT diamond, NOT oval.

Settlement design: circular dirt enclosure, a narrow ring of closely packed small wood post TOPS around its edge. Bottom entry gap with a short rectangular wooden bridge in plan view. Four perfectly circular radial straw roofs placed inside the enclosure around an open centre; four small square hide tent rooftops with symmetric four-way folds interspersed among them. Central round stone campfire ring seen vertically down. Dirt paths winding between these footprints. Sparse green foliage patches, stones, firewood and small racks seen only from the top. Maintain the recognizable Stone Age city contents of the reference but draw all of them from exactly overhead. No people.
Style: finely textured hand-painted game art, rich straw texture, weathered brown wood, pale tan leather, warm ochre dirt, grey stones, small vivid green shrubs. Detailed surfaces with restrained shading and tiny contact shadows. Keep material realism. No architectural blueprint strokes, no abstract symbols.
Layout: square canvas, settlement occupies 80 percent of width, equal generous margins, all contents and bridge contained. True alpha-transparent background outside the circular ground patch. No black background, no checkerboard, no text, no labels, no multi-panel sheet.

KEY ACCEPTANCE CHECK before finishing: see only roof surfaces, ground surfaces, tops of rocks, and tiny tops of posts. A single hut front door or an exterior ring of tall visible fence shafts means the camera is WRONG. Straight overhead is mandatory.
